blocks.text: Atomic spectra quantised photons ka saboot dete hain. Tajurbati intizam mein discharge tube, spectrometer aur diffraction grating shamil hain (Fig 18.9): source ki roshni tang slit aur collimator, jo use mutawazi banata hai, se guzar kar grating par parti aur vernier zawiya scale wali ghoomti telescope se dekhi jati hai. Andhere pas-e-manzar par roshan lakeeron ka silsila nazar aata hai. Mukhtalif anasir ki bhaap lakeeron ke mukhtalif naqshe deti hai, jinhein spectral series kehte hain, aur in se anasir pehchane ja sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Grating spectrometer ka oopar se manzar: lamp aur tang jhiri (narrow slit), roshni ko mutawazi (parallel) banane wali collimator tube, zaviya (angle) scale wali ghoomne wali mez par diffraction grating, aur eyepiece wali telescope jo mez ke gird ghoomti hai. Mutawazi roshni grating se seedhi simt se theta zaviye par nikal kar telescope mein jati hai. Note mein d sin(theta) = n lambda likha hai.
blocks.caption: Diffraction grating spectrometer (Fig 18.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Roshni ki har wavelength apne zaviye par mudti (diffract hoti) hai, is liye telescope ghumane se spectrum ki lakeerein andheri pasmanzar (background) par aik aik kar ke nazar aati hain aur un ke zaviye scale par parhe jate hain.

blocks.text: Aisa aik silsila J. J. Balmer ne 1885 mein atomic hydrogen ke spectrum mein pehchana (Fig 18.10). Nazar aane wale hisse mein is ki chaar lakeerein hain, 656 nm (surkh), 486 nm (neeli-sabz), 434 nm (neeli) aur 410 nm (banafshi) par. J. R. Rydberg ne nataij formula 1/lambda = RH (1/2^2 - 1/n^2) mein bayan kiye, jahan n = 3, 4, 5, ... electron ki excited energy level aur RH = 1.0974 x 10^7 m^-1 Rydberg constant hai. Hydrogen ki spectral lakeerein na-nazar aane wale ultraviolet aur infrared hisson tak bhi phaili hain. Ultraviolet mein Lyman series 1/lambda = RH (1/1^2 - 1/n^2), n = 2, 3, 4, ... (18.12) se milti hai. Infrared mein Paschen series 1/lambda = RH (1/3^2 - 1/n^2), n = 4, 5, 6, ... (18.13) se milti hai.

blocks.title: Rydberg ke formulas
blocks.text: Kitab Balmer aur Lyman formulas ka baen hissa 1/lambda ki jagah 'h/lambda' chhapti hai, aur Lyman series ko 1/1^2 ki jagah 1/2^2 ke saath chhapti hai. Durust shaklein Balmer ke liye 1/lambda = RH(1/2^2 - 1/n^2) aur Lyman ke liye 1/lambda = RH(1/1^2 - 1/n^2) hain. Kitab Balmer ke liye n = 3, 4, 5 aur Lyman ke liye n = 2, 3, 4 bhi batati hai, jo durust formulas se milta hai.

Yeh equations akele hydrogen atom mein electron ki ijazat shuda tawanaiyan deti hain (Figs 18.11 aur 18.12). Halat n = 1 ground state hai; n = 2, 3, 4, ... excited states hain. Atom sirf alag alag miqdaron mein tawanai jazb karta aur kisi excited state mein chala jata hai. Excited states bohat kam der rehti hain: electron jald neeche level par wapas aa kar photon kharij karta hai, aur yeh photons spectral lakeeron ka emission spectrum banate hain. n = 1 par khatam hone wali tabdeeliyan Lyman series, n = 2 par khatam hone wali Balmer series, aur n = 3 par khatam hone wali Paschen series deti hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: andheri patti par Balmer series ki chaar rangeen lakeerein 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par, baen banafshi aur daen surkh. Neeche: hydrogen ka energy-level khaaka, levels n = 1 (-21.8), 2 (-5.45), 3 (-2.42), 4 (-1.36), 5 (-0.86), 6 aur infinity (0), 10^-19 J ikaiyon mein. n = 1 tak neeche ke teer Lyman series (UV), n = 2 tak rangeen teer Balmer series (nazar aane wali), aur n = 3 tak teer Paschen series (IR).
blocks.caption: Atomic hydrogen ke spectra aur energy levels (Figs 18.10 se 18.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har lakeer do levels ke darmiyan aik chhalang se aati hai; chhalang jitni bari, photon utna tawanai wala. n = 1 tak chhalangein sab se bari (ultraviolet); n = 2 tak chhalangein nazar aane wali had mein parti hain.

blocks.text: Jab musalsal spectrum wali roshni, jaise safed roshni, kam dabao ki gas se guzar kar tajziya ki jaye to kuch wavelengths ki roshni ghaib milti hai; un ki jagah andheri lakeerein nazar aati hain. Yeh absorption spectrum hai. Gas se guzarte hue electrons alag alag miqdar ki tawanai jazb kar ke oonche levels par jate hain; sirf khaas tawanaiyon ke photons jazb hote hain, bilkul woh jo aisi oopar ki tabdeeliyon ke liye darkaar hain. Jab excited electrons neeche levels par wapas aate hain to unhi wavelengths ke photons kharij hote aur emission spectrum banate hain. Yun absorption line spectrum se ghaib wavelengths wahi hain jo usi element ke emission line spectrum mein maujood hain (Fig 18.13).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Atom ko excite karne ke liye photon ki tawanai do levels ke farq ke bilkul barabar honi chahiye, hf = En - Ep. Lekin atom se takrane wala electron use excite kar sakta hai agar us ki kinetic energy is farq ke barabar ya zyada ho. Kitab spectrum ki teen qismein bhi dikhati hai: musalsal, line aur band.

blocks.alt: 400 se 700 nm wavelength ke muqable teen pattiyan. Musalsal: banafshi se surkh tak poori dhanak. Hydrogen emission: andheri patti par 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par roshan rangeen lakeerein. Hydrogen absorption: dhanak jis mein bilkul inhi chaar wavelengths par andheri lakeerein.
blocks.caption: Musalsal, emission aur absorption spectra (Fig 18.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Gas bilkul wahi wavelengths jazb karti hai jo kharij kar sakti hai, kyunke dono unhi energy levels ke joron ke darmiyan chhalangon se aati hain.

blocks.text: Kitab ka caption hissa (b) ko absorption aur hissa (c) ko emission spectrum kehta hai, lekin panels par ulat likha hai (b emission, c absorption); panels ke label durust hain.
